metrics.title: Accuracy
metrics.name: accuracy
metrics.description: Proportion of correct predictions over total predictions.

metrics.title: Precision
metrics.name: precision
metrics.description: Proportion of true positive predictions among the top-k predictions.

metrics.title: Recall
metrics.name: recall
metrics.description: Proportion of true positive predictions retrieved among all relevant instances.

metrics.title: F1 Score
metrics.name: f1
metrics.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.
